items: A new default font, Atkinson Hyperlegible, chosen for easy reading. Change it in Settings; the choice applies to every app by this maker on this device.
About this app (under the font choice) shows the version, where your data lives, how much storage it uses, and a Copy diagnostics button for reporting a problem.
You are told when a new version is ready, and if something goes wrong you see a message with a Reload button instead of a frozen screen.
The sync dialog has an Erase everything button for what you have seen, rated and noted on this device, after asking. Your Drive copy is not touched.
Fonts and the map now load from the maker's own site, with no requests to Google Fonts or a code CDN.
AI cowork sync now shows the agent's advice for review before it replaces yours, can run on a schedule from one computer, keeps a history, and can undo.
HD zoom for every credited plate, and artist timelines.
